topic: Free elections (nationwide opposition march 2026-10-22) and university student conditions (UNEARTE demo 2026-10-13)
scale: Thousands of demonstrators in several cities (Caracas, Valencia, Maracay, San Cristobal, Maracaibo); multiple UNEARTE university campuses
quote1: Seeing this makes me happy because I know change is possible,” said 18-year-old cosmetology student Leosmary Hernandez, as she gathered with hundreds of others in northern Maracay.
quote2: On Tuesday, students at the fine arts campus of Venezuela’s National Experimental University of the Arts (UNEARTE) demonstrated and demanded solutions to deteriorating facilities, registration failures, and inadequate student services.
